title: Cardinals hopeful RB Jeremiyah Love can play vs. Chargers in Week 1 after preseason ankle injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals hopeful RB Jeremiyah Love can play vs. Chargers in Week 1 after preseason ankle injury
sources.description: Jeremiyah Love, who the Cardinals took with the No. 3 overall pick in the draft, went down with an ankle sprain earlier in the preseason and has been sidelined ever since.
